description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeSubordinateAPI class in the OrangeHRM project, which covers functionality such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting subordinate employee data via API endpoints. The tests include validation rules, mock service dependencies, and assertions to ensure correct behavior.
